text: Would have been a perfect app, but of course... monthly subscription 😒 (yearly subscription if you take a one week trial and forget to unsubscribe). How did we get to the point that we need to pay monthly taxes to use the most generic and simplest apps??
author: Nikola Prolić
developer_reply: Hello, Nikola! A subscription-based pricing model ensures that you get the most efficient and highly-functional apps for lower costs. We are sorry if the proposed subscription plans do not meet your needs. You can always check out our other apps or, even better, keep an eye out for sales in the store!
